02 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE CODE

A developer’s logic.
A designer’s eye.

Find me on GitHub ↗

Hey, I’m Max. A self-taught developer from Germany who cares about how things work—and how they make people feel.

I build websites for people with something worth sharing. A small business, an independent practice, a fresh idea. My job is to give it a home that feels like you.

My philosophy is simple: every detail should earn its place. Clear structure. Fast pages. Meaningful interactions. And code that someone can confidently build on.

03 / HOW WE GET THERE

No mystery.
Just a good process.

You work directly with me, from our first conversation to the final handover.

01 / DISCOVER

Start with the why.

We talk about your business, your audience, and what your website needs to do. Then we agree on scope and price.

02 / DESIGN

Find your direction.

Structure, typography, and visual identity come together in a design you can review before development begins.

03 / BUILD

Make it feel right.

I turn the design into a responsive website, refining performance, accessibility, and the little interactions.

04 / LAUNCH

Ready for the world.

We review the finished site, check the details, and launch. You get the source and a clear handover.

04 / A CLEAR STARTING POINT

Big on craft.
Clear on cost.

Projects typically range from €500 to €5,000. Your final quote depends on scope, content, and functionality.
